# Nurj

> Nurj is an AI business command centre for Nigerian side hustlers. A free five-question scan places a business in one of four stages (Validation, Launch, Scaling, Exit 9–5), names the single highest-leverage next move, and writes the AI prompt that executes it, personalised to the business and its customers.

Nurj is built for how Nigerian businesses actually sell: WhatsApp, Instagram, referrals and direct outreach, priced in naira.

## What Nurj does

- [Free stage scan](https://nurjai.com/): five questions, no card, no account needed. Shows the business stage and the next move.
- Prompt studio: turns a goal (cold DM, outreach email, pricing, proposal, launch campaign) into a structured prompt personalised to the business.
- Prompt enhancer: rewrites a weak prompt and explains what was wrong with it.
- 30 naira business calculators: break-even, true profit per order after Paystack fees, pricing, loan cost, tax set-aside under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025, ajo planning and more. Free.
- [Stage playbooks](https://nurjai.com/guides/): practical guides for getting clients, pricing, looking professional and selling, by stage.
- Win Log, a Monday momentum email and sector insights to track what works.

## Plans

- Free: stage scan, 5 prompts and 3 enhancements a day, free playbooks, all calculators.
- Builder: ₦10,000 per 30 days. Full prompt studio and enhancer, all playbooks.
- Operator: ₦25,000 per 30 days. Everything in Builder, up to 3 businesses.
- Card payments renew every 30 days and can be turned off at any time. 7-day money-back guarantee.

## Who it is for

- Side hustlers with an idea who want to know if it is a business (Validation).
- People landing their first consistent paying clients (Launch).
- Businesses with steady revenue that need leverage (Scaling).
- Employees planning to leave a 9–5 for their business (Exit 9–5).
